findings.current: Only after the tension finally snapped did the man realize that he had been lying inside a vehicle.
findings.defect: “The tension snapped” can imply that he lost control under pressure, whereas the source says his tension suddenly released in relief.
findings.rationale: 긴장의 끈이 탁 풀린 describes the abrupt release of tension after he realizes he survived.
findings.replacement: Only after the tension finally drained out of him did the man realize that he had been lying inside a vehicle.
findings.source: 비로소 긴장의 끈이 탁 풀린 남자는 그제야 자신이 누워 있던 곳이 차량 내부라는 것을 깨달았다.

findings.current:
“…”

She sighed lightly.

“It’d be faster to give you my business card from the start. Here.”
findings.defect: The draft adds a sigh that is not present in the source and turns an unspoken pause into a specific physical reaction.
findings.rationale: The source contains only the pause before Song Song decides that showing her card will be faster.
findings.replacement:
“…”

“It’d be faster to give you my business card from the start. Here.”
findings.source: “……그냥 처음부터 명함을 주는 게 빠르겠네. 여기요.”

findings.current: “My official position is Team Leader of the healer team. It’s temporary, but I’m also in charge of the emergency rescue team.”
findings.defect: The pronoun “It” can make her official Healer Team position sound temporary. The source says her additional command of the emergency rescue team is temporary.
findings.rationale: 임시지만 modifies her responsibility for the emergency rescue team, not her formal position as Healer Team Leader.
findings.replacement: “My official title is Healer Team Leader. I’m also temporarily in charge of the emergency rescue team.”
findings.source: “정식 직함은 힐러팀 팀장이죠. 임시지만 긴급 구조팀을 맡고 있기도 하고.”

findings.current: It was the Guild led by none other than Jin Taekyung.
findings.defect: The draft changes Jin Taekyung from someone who belongs to the Peace Guild into its leader, altering his organizational role.
findings.rationale: 속한 means that Jin Taekyung is affiliated with or belongs to the Guild; it does not say that he leads it.
findings.replacement: It was the Guild that none other than Jin Taekyung belonged to.
findings.source: 다른 사람도 아닌 바로 그 진태경이 속한 길드가 아닌가.

findings.current: *…That sounds like a line I’ve heard somewhere before. First, just know that I’m not Chinese.*
findings.defect: “Chinese” broadens 화교 into nationality and loses the specific reference to a member of the ethnic Chinese diaspora.
findings.rationale: 화교 specifically denotes an ethnic Chinese person living outside China, rather than any Chinese national.
findings.replacement: *…That sounds like a line I’ve heard somewhere before. First, just know that I’m not ethnic Chinese.*
findings.source: ‘……어디서 많이 들어 본 대사 같은데. 우선 내가 화교가 아니라는 것만 알아 둬.’

findings.current: But what followed completely exceeded her expectations.
findings.defect: “Exceeded her expectations” adds the positive judgment that his proposal was better than expected. The source only says it went completely against what she had anticipated.
findings.rationale: 예상을 완전히 빗나갔다 means that her prediction was completely wrong, without itself stating that the reality surpassed it in quality.
findings.replacement: But what he said next was nothing like what she had expected.
findings.source: 골드문, 아니 아레스 길드에 들어가 첩자 짓이라도 하라는 건가 잠깐 생각했지만, 이어진 이야기는 그녀의 예상을 완전히 빗나갔다.

findings.current: Every now and then, the bastard showed her an unexpected side of himself.
findings.defect: “The bastard” introduces stronger hostility and profanity than the familiar, mildly disparaging 녀석 warrants in this reflective context.
findings.rationale: Here 녀석 conveys casual familiarity rather than the force of an explicit insult.
findings.replacement: Every now and then, he showed her an unexpected side of himself.
findings.source: 녀석은 가끔 이렇게 뜻밖의 모습을 보여 주고는 했다.

findings.current: “You there. Your waist is bent at only an eighty-degree angle. Lower it to ninety. Alternatively, attempting a grandjeol would be an excellent option.”
findings.defect: The untranslated culture-specific joke “grandjeol” is left unexplained, so an English reader cannot understand the Skeleton King’s escalating demand for an absurdly extreme bow.
findings.rationale: 그랜절 is internet slang combining “grand” with the Korean full bow, and its exaggerated physical image is the punchline.
findings.replacement:
“You there. You’re only bending eighty degrees at the waist. Make it ninety. Or you could try a grandjeol.[^1]”

[^1]: A comically exaggerated form of the Korean full bow, often performed with the body inverted.
findings.source: “거기 너, 허리 각도가 80도밖에 되지 않는다. 90도까지 낮추도록. 아니면 그랜절을 시도하는 것도 좋은 방법이다.”

findings.current:
“One more word, and you’ll learn to listen while kneeling.”

“…”

A single sentence was enough to shut him up.

Team Leader Choi handed me a folder.
findings.defect: The Skeleton King’s spoken apology is omitted, removing the comic beat in which he immediately submits to Taekyung’s threat.
findings.rationale: 미안하다 explicitly means “Sorry”; the source does not leave his response as silence.
findings.replacement:
“One more word, and you’ll learn to listen while kneeling.”

“…Sorry.”

That single sentence was enough to shut him up.

Team Leader Choi handed me a folder.
findings.source:
“한마디만 더 하면 무릎 꿇은 채로 들을 줄 알아라.”

“……미안하다.”

단 한마디로 녀석의 입을 닥치게 만든 내게, 최 팀장이 서류철 하나를 내밀었다.

summary: The draft contains one organizational-role error, several meaningful register or characterization shifts, one omitted apology, and localized wording issues.
